item.title: King County crash leaves Lubbock man deceased, 1 injured

item.title: Former 'person of interest' in Ysasaga case pleads guilty to federal meth charge
item.description: Christian Castro, a former person of interest in the Mark Ysasaga case, was sentenced to 12 years and 4 months in federal prison on an unrelated narcotics trafficking charge, while Jose Simental was served with a warrant for Ysasaga's murder and later pleaded guilty to Tampering with Evidence, receiving a 7 year sentence.
